steps.title: Taskbar and groups
steps.instruction: Focus a different window using its taskbar group.

steps.title: Applications and search
steps.instruction: Open Applications and enter a search.

steps.title: Window switcher
steps.instruction: Open the window switcher and inspect the candidate.

steps.title: Task View
steps.instruction: Open Task View and inspect the workspace filters.

steps.title: Empty workspace
steps.instruction: Select workspace 3, then choose Go to workspace 3.

steps.title: Move a window
steps.instruction: Open Task View, choose Move for a window, and inspect the destinations.

steps.title: Return to the editor group
steps.instruction: Open the window switcher and activate an Editor or Notes window. This returns you from the empty workspace and focuses the two-window editor group.

steps.title: Window picker and previews
steps.instruction: Open a group with multiple windows and inspect its previews.

steps.title: Activate a window
steps.instruction: Select the other window in the picker. Warlock switches to its workspace and focuses it, ready for window actions.

steps.title: Float the window
steps.instruction: Drag the focused window by its title bar to make it floating. Floating windows support snap layouts. Show me performs the same drag.

steps.title: Snap layouts
steps.instruction: Open the snap layouts for the floating window and inspect the available regions.

steps.title: Window actions
steps.instruction: Open a window’s actions and inspect its available controls.

steps.title: Application actions
steps.instruction: Open application actions and inspect the declared and recent actions.

steps.title: Notifications
steps.instruction: Open Notifications and inspect its entries.

steps.title: Appearance
steps.instruction: Open Settings and inspect appearance choices.

steps.title: Motion
steps.instruction: In Settings, choose a different motion preference. It remains a draft until you save it.

steps.title: Shortcuts
steps.instruction: Choose a different available shortcut option for Applications. Save shortcut choices applies the draft.

steps.title: Inline help
steps.instruction: Choose Show help in Settings to read keyboard and recovery guidance.

steps.title: Files
steps.instruction: Open Files and inspect the current location and collections.

steps.title: System
steps.instruction: Open System and inspect the session facts.

steps.title: Inline confirmation
steps.instruction: Choose a session operation, then cancel its inline confirmation.

steps.title: Status and recovery
steps.instruction: Open Files and choose Refresh to read its current status without repeating an operation.
